_comment: Fully market-data driven. Each grade is anchored to a TRADED benchmark and priced as realization x anchor ($/lb). anchor='p1020' => LME aluminum + Midwest Premium (wrought/clean). anchor='alloy' => LME NASAAC / Aluminium Alloy secondary contract (cast/secondary). realization values are fixed public-spread estimates; update them from published market spreads, not tickets.
_midwest_premium_note: Used for dates with no row in data/midwest_premium.csv. Elevated by Section 232 tariffs — keep current.
_alloy_note: NASAAC is already a North American delivered price, so no Midwest add by default. If you supply the European LME Aluminium Alloy contract instead, set a delivery premium here.

mixed_low_copper.note: feeds secondary; realization vs ALLOY anchor

old_cast.note: die-cast feed; realization vs ALLOY anchor
